observations: Line 3 compares item.owner to actor with strict inequality and throws Error("denied") for non-owners, matching the stated contract.
Line 2 calls load(id) without a null/undefined check; if load returns undefined for an unknown id, line 3 would throw a TypeError rather than the intended denial Error.
Authorization is enforced only after load(id) executes on line 2, so the record is fetched before the owner check on line 3.
The owner check on line 3 is a plain string comparison with no normalization, so case or whitespace differences in actor would be treated as non-owner.
Probe p1 invoice(7, "bob") should reach line 3 and throw Error("denied"); probe p2 invoice(7, "alice") should pass line 3 and return 40 from line 4.
The function returns item.amount directly on line 4 with no further validation of the amount value.
